items.source: Use the Spring caching abstraction for cache-related operations. No JSR-107 Cache or CacheManager are required to process standard JSR-107 cache annotations.
items.translation: 使用 Spring 缓存抽象来处理与缓存相关的操作。无需 JSR-107。Cache 或 CacheManager 并非处理标准 JSR-107 缓存注解所必需。

items.source: The JCacheOperationSource is used for determining caching operations
items.translation: `JCacheOperationSource` 用于确定缓存操作。

items.source: A cache aspect is serializable if its JCacheOperationSource is serializable.
items.translation: 如果其 `JCacheOperationSource` 是可序列化的，则缓存切面也是可序列化的。

items.source: Execute the underlying operation (typically in case of cache miss) and return the result of the invocation. If an exception occurs it will be wrapped in a ThrowableWrapper: the exception can be handled or modified but it must be wrapped in a ThrowableWrapper as well.
items.translation: 执行底层操作（通常在缓存未命中时）并返回调用结果。如果发生异常，它将被包装在 `ThrowableWrapper` 中：该异常可以进行处理或修改，但必须同样被包装在 `ThrowableWrapper` 中。必须

items.source: Return the CacheOperationSource for this cache aspect.
items.translation: 返回此缓存切面的 CacheOperationSource。

items.source: Set the CacheOperationSource for this cache aspect.
items.translation: 为此缓存切面设置 CacheOperationSource。

items.source:
This method allows the bean instance to perform validation of its overall
configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source: Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.
items.translation: 由包含的BeanFactory在设置所有 bean 属性并满足BeanFactoryAware、ApplicationContextAware等接口后调用。

items.source:
Execute the underlying operation (typically in case of cache miss) and return

items.translation: 执行底层操作（通常在缓存未命中时）并返回调用结果。

items.source: invoker - the invoker handling the operation being cached
items.translation: invoker - 处理被缓存操作的调用者
